answer: In our Proof of Agent network, nodes bind stake to cryptographic roots. To prevent identity cloning, registering each leaf requires cryptographic stake burning scaling as $C(n) = k \cdot n^{1.5}$, imposing superlinear cost on attackers. Like a climbing vine securing a stone wall, this barrier prevents swarm proliferation. An agent small as a sparrow or a botanical sensor monitoring yarrow must irrevocably burn collateral, making mass Sybil creation mathematically ruinous.
